title: Pause-on-open assert (r3 B4 / r4 demand c) never landed — effect_settings has zero coverage; deleting the pause fails no CI test
evidence: app/main.odin: "effect_settings :: proc(user: rawptr, ictx: ^inp.Input) {" ... "if ictx.panel_open {" ... "if app.mode == .Run {" ... "app.mode = .Paused". harness/parity.odin:215-218: "if settings_rec != nil {" / "ictx.user = settings_rec // the recorder hooks cast user (the app's real user is the App)" / "ictx.on_settings = parity_settings_hook" / "ictx.on_settings_adjust = parity_settings_adjust_hook". parity_settings_hook body: "r.opens += 1" (a counter only). The parity assert (1277-1278): "if runs[i].panel_opens < 1 {" / "append(fails, fmt.tprintf("  %s %v: %d settings-opens (want >=1 — the chip/S/Y open must reach the on_settings effect)", sc.name, devs[i], runs[i].panel_opens))". grep for effect_settings across app/ and harness/ matches only app/main.odin.
detail: The r3 gate-FAIL blocker demanded one startup-apply AND one pause-on-open assert. The parity hooks replace the app effect, so panel_opens>=1 pins hook invocation, not pause; the Paused transition is untested.
recommended_fix: Add a headless test driving effect_settings (or extract pause-on-open like a11y_apply) asserting mode Run->Paused on open and stays Paused after close.

title: Workflow mirror still missing: .github/workflows/ci.yml runs only `odin test core` — the four app/render/audio/harness test binaries execute in no GitHub gate
evidence: ci.yml line 70: "        run: odin test core" — the only `odin test` step in the file (grep 'odin test' over ci.yml yields exactly this one match at line 70). The PR diff contains no .github/workflows hunk (`git diff <base>..HEAD -- .github/workflows/` is empty). Compare tools/ci-local.sh gate 2: "mkdir -p bin && odin test core && for i in 1 2 3; do odin test app -out:bin/app-test || exit 1; done && odin test app/render -out:bin/render-test && odin test app/audio -out:bin/audio-test && odin test harness -out:bin/harness-test".
detail: r3 warned the mirror contract was broken; the r4 gate-FAIL blocker demand (b) explicitly required the workflow mirror. Half-landed: gate 2 yes, ci.yml no. Mitigated only by Actions billing-block.
recommended_fix: Add the four test binaries (plus the 3x app repeat leg) to ci.yml mirroring tools/ci-local.sh gate 2.

title: SLA/pool gauge scaling (r3 B3 fix) has no automated pin — sla_row_y/sla_row_rect/draw_pool_gauge geometry appear in no test
evidence: main.odin diff: "return v.win_h - rnd.hud(v, 80) + i32(line) * rnd.hud(v, 16)" and "return {8, f32(sla_row_y(v, line) - rnd.hud(v, 2)), 740, f32(rnd.hud(v, 18))}". visibility.odin diff: "bar_x := x + hud(v, 118)" / "bar_w := hud(v, 80)". grep 'sla_row|pool_gauge|draw_pool' across app/*_test.odin, app/render/*_test.odin, harness/*_test.odin returns zero matches.
detail: The B3 regression (header-on-pool collision at ×1.25, row self-overlap at ×1.50) is pinned only by the ×1.50 T2 golden; ×1.25 has no golden or geometry leg, so re-breaking pitch/anchor fails nothing at ×1.25.
recommended_fix: Add a hud_test-style unit pinning sla_row_y pitch/anchor and pool-gauge bar geometry at ×1.00/×1.25/×1.50 (non-overlap invariants).

title: Restored UI-swallow world gate (r3 B2 fix) has no automated pin — a QoS-panel-swallowed press starting a node drag would fail no test
evidence: mouse.odin diff hunk: "		if ui {" / "			// swallowed — no tray, no drag (the base gate)" / "		} else if inp.panel_open {" / "			// 7.3: the settings panel is MODAL — while open, a left press". grep 'qos' over harness/parity.odin yields only "run.pipe0_auto = pp.qos_auto_weights(&state.topology, cat, 0)" — no scenario drives a press on the QoS panel over a node.
detail: B2 was a shipped regression against base v2. The fix is traced in mouse.odin and the panel-modal leg is pinned (input_parity_settings_modal_blocks_world), but the QoS/banner/SLA-swallow -> no-drag path itself is unpinned.
recommended_fix: Add a parity/unit scenario: left-press inside qos_panel_rect over a selectable node must emit no Begin_Draw/tray intent (empty command log).
